326.sql:
WITH c_cols AS (
    SELECT a.molecule_id
    FROM atom AS a
    WHERE a.element = 's'
),
c_cols_bond AS (
    SELECT c.molecule_id, b.bond_type
    FROM c_cols AS c
    INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
),
c_rows AS (
    SELECT c.molecule_id
    FROM c_cols_bond AS c
    WHERE c.bond_type = '='
)
SELECT m.label
FROM c_rows AS c
INNER JOIN molecule AS m ON c.molecule_id = m.molecule_id;

stats.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.molecule_id FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.element = 's' AND T2.bond_type = '='
